message: Redis cluster topology refresh failed: CLUSTERDOWN The cluster is down. Nodes: redis-1.prod:6379, redis-2.prod:6379 are isolated from redis-3.prod:6379, redis-4.prod:6379. Network partition detected between AZ us-east-1a and us-east-1b.

Redis cluster has no primary. Split-brain: both halves elected a primary for slot 0-8191. Last successful topology refresh: 2024-09-03T10:58:00Z. All WRITE operations failing. READ fallback to replica: partial coverage.
Cart session writes failing 100%: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError CLUSTERDOWN. Fallback to DB writes overwhelmed Postgres — connection pool exhausted. POST /v1/orders returning 500.

AZ isolation event: transit gateway route table update at 10:57:00Z caused route withdrawal for subnet 10.1.2.0/24 (us-east-1a Redis nodes). Packets dropped between AZs since 10:58:00Z. Network operations investigating.
Redis CLUSTER FAILOVER completed after 5m00s. Primary elected in us-east-1b. Transit gateway route restored at 11:04:00Z. Redis cluster recovering — slot reassignment in progress.
